slots.notes: Per-card fullbleed looping background video, object-cover, autoplay/muted/playsInline, sitting behind a tinted color overlay and the stat content block (one video per stat card)

mechanic: On-scroll reveal of a stat section where a blur-in heading sits above a stagger-children row of three video-backed cards (each fading up y:30->0) that flex from a stacked column on mobile to a bottom-aligned desktop row where the shorter middle card creates a staggered baseline.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion (standalone section component with a reusable BlurIn useInView wrapper)
reskinNotes: Three card overlay tints double as the per-card surface/accent colors and are baked inline as Tailwind arbitrary rgba values (bg-[rgba(...)]) on each card, so reskinning requires editing markup not a token file; headline, paragraph, all stat numbers and descriptions, and card min-heights (450/350/450) are hardcoded in the component, and the staggered bottom-alignment layout depends on those fixed heights plus Helvetica Neue font metrics (tracking-[-0.03em], leading-[60px]).
